entries.style_notes: D&D provides the lizardfolk analogue, but the consulted public species listing does not establish a gendered naming grammar. Fortcamp proposes clipped hiss-and-click personal names and optional habitat or work bynames; many use only a personal name, and vowel endings never signal an official D&D rule.

entries.style_notes: Official D&D identifies Astral Elves and describes general elven adult and family-name patterns, but the consulted public sources do not establish a distinct astral-elf naming grammar. entries.style_notes: Voidsent are an original Fortcamp extraplanar grouping, not a claim about D&D or Final Fantasy cultures. Their personal names pair low resonant vowels with interrupted or fricative consonants; optional cell, port, or chosen bynames denote actual associations only, and neither demonic rank nor cosmic powers follow from a name.
